page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg9i.16xlarge is a virtual machine instance built on the KVM hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 6982P-C processor with an x86_64 architecture and a clock speed of 3.4 GHz. The instance is equipped with 256.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance does not include local storage or onboard GPUs, meaning all storage requirements must be met through external network-attached block storage. It provides a baseline network bandwidth of 36 Gbps and does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing capabilities without resource contention from other tenants.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.hfg9i.16xlarge offers a high-density compute profile with dedicated resources, making it suitable for enterprise workloads that require stable CPU performance and a balanced memory-to-core ratio. The lack of bundled local storage and GPUs represents a tradeoff, optimizing the instance for workloads that rely on network-attached storage and do not require hardware acceleration. Appropriate workloads include general-purpose enterprise applications, web serving, and database hosting.
